text: Code reviews are a vital practice in software development, where team members examine each other’s code before it is merged. One of their main benefits is catching bugs early, which saves time and money compared to fixing errors after release. Besides finding mistakes, reviews are excellent for knowledge sharing; developers learn new techniques and become familiar with different parts of the codebase. This process also raises overall team quality by encouraging clear, maintainable code and consistent standards. While they require extra effort, code reviews build trust and collaboration, making the final product stronger and the team more skilled.
